arStrings.szText: This Council has reached a decision. We find Captain Tharra most fit to bear the Amazon crown. May she lead us through hardship and heal what has been broken.
Tharra, do you swear to live and rule by the oaths of our foremothers? To be the first in the charge and the last in the retreat.
Ceremonial and authoritative. Clear, deliberate enunciation with steady rhythm
By blood and steel, by hearth and sea. I swear it. This I vow, until the earth takes me and the waves wash my name away.
Then arise, Tharra. Queen of Amazons and protector of the Skovos Isles!
Strong and ceremonial - voice rising with pride and finality
